description:
About our brand and products:
Mob Dark makes aggressive statement jewelry in solid stainless steel. Heavy chains, spiked pieces, barbed wire, blades, skulls. Built for people who've been alternative their whole life, not people trying it on for a weekend.

What makes us different:
Nothing we make is hollow, plated, or pulled from the same catalog every other brand uses. Solid steel, oversized links, designed in-house. If it looks like it could hurt someone, it shipped. If it looks safe, it didn't.

How affiliates can earn:
15% of every sale through your link or code. Their whole cart counts, not just the piece you posted, and the window runs 30 days from the click.

If your content's good, we notice. Top creators get moved onto monthly retainers, paid content deals, and early access to drops. The affiliate link is the front door, not the ceiling.

How to promote us:
Wear the pieces in your normal content. Fit checks, tattoo work, gig shots, whatever you already post. Real beats staged every time — our best content is just the steel on real people. Grab banners and product shots from the Marketing Tool tab if you need them.
term_and_condition:
MOB DARK AFFILIATE TERMS

Welcome in. Here's how it works and where you stand. By signing up you're agreeing to all of it.


1. Approval

We approve or reject applications at our discretion. No appeals process, no legal recourse. If it's not a fit, it's not a fit.


2. Links and codes

Your affiliate link generates automatically, and you can create links for specific products or collections. Last click wins — if someone clicks another affiliate's link and then yours, the sale is yours.

Some affiliates get a coupon code, some don't. Check your dashboard. If a customer uses both your link and your code, you get paid once, not twice. No code assigned means you don't promote one.

Push it wherever you want — Instagram, Facebook, print, whatever works.


3. Getting paid

You earn commission on the order value. Tax and shipping don't count toward it.

Add your payment details in Settings or nothing can go out. Payment schedule is on the Affiliate Guide page. Only completed transactions pay — chargebacks and refunds don't. Every referral order gets reviewed under fair use.

Commission status lives in the Commission tab, payment history in the Payment tab.


4. Marketing assets

Banners, logos and promo media sit in the Marketing Tool tab. Download them or grab the embed code.


5. Network

If the Network tab is on, you can bring other affiliates in under you. Their sales earn you a network commission on top. Share your network link, anyone who signs up through it is your downline.


6. Tracking

We track through cookies. Someone blocks or clears theirs, we can't see them, and we can't pay on what we can't see.

Your cookie window starts when they click your link or use your code. Every order they place inside that window pays you, no second click needed.


7. Leaving

Want out? Email care@mobdark.com and you're out.

That's everything. Questions go to care@mobdark.com.
